capabilities: : Match new notes against open questions
extras: Pro features require a local semantic engine that runs on the desktop only, and all data processing remains local. The engine download is verified against a checksum.
intentEvidence: Standing Questions makes a question a first-class object: it has a state, it has sub-questions, and it watches for its own answer.
problem: Users often write down questions but lose track of them, and later notes that answer those questions go unnoticed.
